■ Stage Direction

Yes. It's just a quick run-through, but I finished warming up and stretching...
Oh, and I also prepared some equipment we might need, just in case.

Even so, my colleague's concerns were valid. Signing her as-is
wouldn't be in K.S. Miracle's best interest above all else.

Even though that was why I'd always been turned down before...
When you reached out to me, I got carried away.

Beneath her quiet demeanor lay an unyielding resolve. ...What I'd heard recently came to mind.
'Work even harder'—she was definitely the type to do just that.

My doctor and parents are coming to watch me.
All the precious people in my life... who took such good care of me.

It was almost like I tricked you into a contract without explaining my situation.
I'm sure that must have troubled you, right?

No, I'm already full...
I have a rather small appetite, you see—

Huh?! But... are you sure that's okay?
Trainer, aren't you busy...?

Even for a contract that would shape her entire life, she was willing
to walk away out of consideration for me. Her compassion for others ran deeper than I'd ever imagined.

You looked troubled when I walked in, too...
I'm sorry. Let's just pretend none of this happened.

Yes, that's part of it, but... the Disciplinary Track Meet
is an event where visitors from outside the academy can come watch.

Did I get too carried away? Ahaha...
It's just such an important chance, I want to do everything I possibly can.

Listen closely, K.S. Miracle. You don't have to give up on anything.
...It's going to be okay. We'll be right beside you.

My legs didn't have enough strength to run, or even walk...
Most of the time, I couldn't even leave my bed.

...Um, are you really sure you should treat me to a meal?
You're already overseeing my training and everything.

I asked if she was really finished eating. Just two carrot râpées sandwiches
seemed far too little for an Umamusume's stomach...

Always earnest, giving everything she had...
My days of training alongside K.S. Miracle went on.
? Yes. I've signed up for it.

Oh, but when you told me I was fast,
it made me so very happy!!
Yet now, I'm able to run like this with everything I've got. ...It truly is amazing, isn't it?

I wish I'd realized it sooner when you said you were a rookie...
It hit me later that you probably didn't know about my body's condition.

No! Just rehydrating is fine.
Once we head back to the academy, I'm ready for the next routine...!

*sigh*... Thank you for the meal!
The carrot râpées sandwiches were delicious.
Amazing... That's amazing, Kei-chan, amazing!! Look how fast you are!

Look what I brought today—homemade banana mousse!
I made it extra, extra soft so it's easy for you to eat.

I gently shook my head in response. I was already full—
my heart completely overflowing from the boundless warmth she radiated.
Right!! ...My arm swing...!

I'll take yesterday's words to heart... and try my absolute best
to earn a contract. ...I'll work harder, and harder.

...When I was little, I couldn't eat much at all.
That was why I was hospitalized for so long, too.

Phew...! Ah, Trainer!
Thank you for coming.

...Ah, I'm sorry for rambling on for so long! Um...
Trainer, would you like to order anything? Dessert, perhaps?

Even now, people still worry about my health, so...
At the meet, I want to show everyone that I'm completely fine now.

So this time, it's my turn. I want to pay back what I've received.
Through my running. —By winning a GⅠ.

That's why this has been such an immense help! Even if it's only temporary,
having you coach me like this, Trainer... means the world to me.

The next day, in the Trainer's office.
...I rehearsed the apology I'd spent all night agonizing over.

Eat as much as you can, and let's do our best with your walking therapy.
Your mom and I will be working hard right alongside you. ...We're always right here.

Gritting my teeth against the frustration and heartache,
just as I was about to bow my head—

That's why I want to give it my all. As much as I possibly can.
...I'm in your hands, Trainer!

—I'm so sorry. You don't have to worry about the contract at all; please just forget about it.
That's all I came to tell you today.

A few days later. When I arrived at the track ahead of our scheduled
training session—
*pant, pant...*! Phew...
*pant, pant, pant, pant—!!*

Kei-chan! Were you reading a picture book? My, what a lovely swan.
...Thank goodness, you seem to be feeling well today.

—Looking good, keep up that rhythm!
Let's try picking up the pace, as long as it's comfortable for you!!

And so, carrying such deep compassion and gentleness in her heart...
Just how far would she push herself, all 'to repay her debts'?

Everything I have was given to me by everyone.
My life, my body, my legs, my dreams. ...Even miracles.

Nothing says it's impossible. Do you want to run around full of energy?
Then that's what you should do. Making that possible is our job.

Whether I managed to speak out of some irresponsible concern,
or merely out of an urge to clear my conscience... I honestly couldn't tell.

Excuse me.
...! ...Trainer.

Then, with the meet fast approaching, I decided to take
K.S. Miracle out for dinner to help her unwind, but—
